en.headline: Wong Chun-ting and Chan Ho-wah take men’s doubles silver at WTT Sweden Smash
en.dek: The Hong Kong pair, defending champions, fell 0-3 to France’s Alexis and Félix Lebrun in the final, completing a hat-trick of doubles silvers for the SAR side.
body: Hong Kong’s Wong Chun-ting and Chan Ho-wah finished runners-up in the men’s doubles at the WTT Europe Smash in Sweden after losing the final 0-3 to France’s Alexis and Félix Lebrun.
The Lebrun brothers won 11-7, 11-8, 14-12. Wong and Chan had reached the final by overcoming Japan’s Togami and Shinozuka in a five-game semi-final.
The result gave Hong Kong three doubles silvers at the event, following earlier runners-up finishes in mixed doubles for Wong and Doo Hoi-kem and in women’s doubles for Doo and Wu Yung-lin.

zh.headline: 黃鎮廷陳顥樺瑞典大滿貫男雙奪銀 不敵法國勒布倫兄弟
zh.dek: 衛冕組合決賽直落三局負於法國眼鏡兄弟，港隊本屆双打共取得三面銀牌。
body: 香港乒乓組合黃鎮廷／陳顥樺在WTT瑞典大滿貫男雙決賽，以0比3不敵法國阿歷斯·勒布倫／菲力斯·勒布倫，奪得銀牌。
法國組合以11比7、11比8及14比12取勝。黃鎮廷／陳顥樺此前在準決賽以3比2力克日本戶上隼輔／篠塚大登晉級。
連同早前混雙黃鎮廷／杜凱琹及女雙杜凱琹／吳詠琳的亞軍，港隊本屆賽事共收穫三面雙打銀牌。
